summary: Local previews stop retrying rejected logins and can reconnect after a new login; refused worker connections no longer produce duplicate-close errors.

evidence: Requested investigation and bounded fixes for production auth errors and API memory. Independent review verified HTTP and both API WebSocket recovery paths, unchanged server authorization, and single-close worker rejection handling. Verified 82 focused unit tests, real API refresh rotation, both remote-runner lifecycle tests, and API type/lint checks. Allocator tuning was rolled back after production latency could not be validated; no allocator setting ships in this PR.
